description: This file implements classes and methods for managing QUIC connection IDs, including peer-issued and self-issued connection ID managers, handling connection ID frames, retirement, and related alarms within the QUIC protocol.

classes.name: RetirePeerIssuedConnectionIdAlarm
classes.description: Alarm delegate class for retiring peer-issued connection IDs.

classes.name: RetireSelfIssuedConnectionIdAlarmDelegate
classes.description: Alarm delegate class for retiring self-issued connection IDs.

classes.name: QuicConnectionIdData
classes.description: Data structure representing a connection ID with associated sequence number and reset token.

classes.name: QuicPeerIssuedConnectionIdManager
classes.description: Manages connection IDs issued by the peer, including adding, retiring, and tracking active IDs.

classes.name: QuicSelfIssuedConnectionIdManager
classes.description: Manages self-issued connection IDs, including issuing, retiring, and consuming IDs.

methods.name: QuicConnectionIdData
methods.description: Constructor for QuicConnectionIdData.

methods.name: QuicPeerIssuedConnectionIdManager
methods.description: Constructor for managing peer-issued connection IDs.

methods.name: IsConnectionIdNew
methods.description: Checks if a connection ID is new.

methods.name: PrepareToRetireConnectionIdPriorTo
methods.description: Prepares connection IDs to be retired before a specified sequence number.

methods.name: OnNewConnectionIdFrame
methods.description: Handles a new connection ID frame received.

methods.name: ConsumeOneUnusedConnectionId
methods.description: Consumes and returns one unused connection ID.

methods.name: PrepareToRetireActiveConnectionId
methods.description: Prepares an active connection ID for retirement.

methods.name: MaybeRetireUnusedConnectionIds
methods.description: Retires unused connection IDs not on the active path.

methods.name: IsConnectionIdActive
methods.description: Checks if a connection ID is active.

methods.name: ConsumeToBeRetiredConnectionIdSequenceNumbers
methods.description: Returns sequence numbers of connection IDs to be retired.

methods.name: ReplaceConnectionId
methods.description: Replaces an old connection ID with a new one.

methods.name: RetireSelfIssuedConnectionIdAlarmDelegate
methods.description: Alarm delegate for retiring self-issued connection IDs.

methods.name: QuicSelfIssuedConnectionIdManager
methods.description: Constructor for managing self-issued connection IDs.

methods.name: MaybeIssueNewConnectionId
methods.description: Attempts to issue a new connection ID.

methods.name: MaybeIssueNewConnectionIdForPreferredAddress
methods.description: Issues a new connection ID for preferred address.

methods.name: OnRetireConnectionIdFrame
methods.description: Handles a retire connection ID frame.

methods.name: GetUnretiredConnectionIds
methods.description: Returns all unretired connection IDs.

methods.name: GetOneActiveConnectionId
methods.description: Returns one active connection ID.

methods.name: RetireConnectionId
methods.description: Retires a connection ID.

methods.name: MaybeSendNewConnectionIds
methods.description: Sends new connection IDs if needed.

methods.name: HasConnectionIdToConsume
methods.description: Checks if there are connection IDs to consume.

methods.name: ConsumeOneConnectionId
methods.description: Consumes and returns one connection ID.

methods.name: IsConnectionIdInUse
methods.description: Checks if a connection ID is in use.
